limits: Original callbacks and all selected game/input/packet access helpers execute unhooked to JNI endpoints. Native callbacks bind actual recovered functions.

Actual native JNI targets and meaningful arguments are compared. The legacy variadic fixture reads five slot1e8 values; the original call-site schedule selects the meaningful four/five for comparison, so unused stack contents are not evidence.
Typed settings/state use independent allocations, matched to original globals by test adapters; other game/JNI records are explicit fixture allocations.
Java behavior, metadata discovery, invalid handles/counts, initialization, allocation ownership, concurrent scheduling and live wiring remain open.
UI/settings and labels are outside this connected callback matrix.
